forms.label: Raw
forms.sourceNote: Spinach, raw. Public domain. The record's own cup portion (0.127 g/ml) is a packing density, not a true one — the volume of a cup of whole leaves, mostly air. Once blended into a smoothie the leaf disperses into the liquid rather than displacing air, so the density-classes.json 'water-like' class stands in, since raw spinach is well over 90% water, and the figure is marked estimated.
